# miniz

Unmodified miniz 3.1.2 sources from https://github.com/richgel999/miniz/tree/3.1.2.
MIT license: ../../third_party/miniz-LICENSE.txt.

CMake generates the static-library export header and disables archive, stdio, time
and zlib-compatible symbol aliases. Only bounded zlib/DEFLATE state compression
is used. No dynamic runtime dependency is added.
